name: Unity Tutorial
goalName: Create a clear tutorial showing the core actions of the game.
goal: The group got feedback that it was not clear to the player that the owl was clickable. For novice users, the game might be a bit overwhelming as well. A solution for this is a tutorial showing step by step what the player can do. It is important to make it very clear, so the young target group can understand.
